passages.text: Lampranthus multiradiatus, synonyms including Lampranthus roseus, known as the creeping redflush{{citation needed|date=January 2024}} or rosy dewplant, is a species of shrub in the family Aizoaceae (stone plants). They are succulent plants with grey-green shoots. They have a self-supporting growth form and simple, broad leaves. The daisy type flowers have yellow centres and petals that vary between pink and purple depending on the season.
